data.title: 萝丝 · 水门下的提灯
data.description: 地底水门里只听见涨潮声。萝丝在石阶尽头停住，把灯提到及膝的位置，让金属门上的旧铭牌露出来。黑色兜帽的银扣接住一点暖光，靴边的积水映着她的身影。
data.location: 旧城地下运河的石阶与水门
data.action: 提灯查看金属门上的旧铭牌
data.lighting: 灯笼从低位照出银扣、门框与水面边缘
data.promptProse: At the bottom of the old canal steps, Rose lifts a small lantern just high enough to read the plate on a metal door. Silver clasps catch its glow against her hooded cloak and black stealth suit. Water gathers at the edges of her boots and reflects a thin band of amber light.
data.animaCaption: The lantern stays at knee height, picking out the silver clasps and the wet stone step.
